title: The Rehman Family Treasure

characters.mum: Mum: white hijab, blue floral dress
characters.dad: Dad: white kurta, short black hair
characters.aizah: Aizah, 8: white hijab, pink top with strawberries
characters.grandpa: Grandpa: grey hair, glasses, beige cardigan (no lines)

lines.text: In a happy little house in Sydney lived the Rehman family.
lines.spoken: In a happy little house in Sydney lived the Rehman family.
lines.hero: the Rehman House sign at sunset

lines.text: Mum, Dad, Jazaa, Aizah and their big brother Hamd.
lines.spoken: Mum, Dad, Jazaa, Aizah and their big brother Hamd.
lines.hero: each family member lights up as their name is said

lines.text: Dad, my friend says the family with the most money wins. Are we rich?
lines.spoken: Dad, my friend says the family with the most money wins. Are we rich?
lines.hero: Hamd at the dinner table, curious

lines.text: Ah, Hamd. We have a treasure bigger than any money. Shall we find it together?
lines.spoken: Ah, Hamd. We have a treasure bigger than any money. Shall we find it together?
lines.hero: Dad smiling, a treasure map unrolls

lines.text: A treasure hunt! Yes!
lines.spoken: A treasure hunt! Yes!

lines.text: Clue number one was in the kitchen.
lines.spoken: Clue number one was in the kitchen.

lines.text: Dad works long days, and I work hard too, so you can have food, school and a warm home.
lines.spoken: Dad works long days, and I work hard too, so you can have food, school and a warm home.
lines.hero: Mum in the kitchen; Dad leaving for work at dawn

lines.text: That's why we spend wisely, and buy only what we really need.
lines.spoken: That's why we spend wisely, and buy only what we really need.
lines.hero: a shopping list: needs ticked, wants crossed

lines.text: And we never waste food, right Mum?
lines.spoken: And we never waste food, right Mum?

lines.text: Never. Take a little, finish it all, and say Alhamdulillah.
lines.spoken: Never. Take a little, finish it all, and say Alhamdulillah.

lines.text: Clue number two was at the front door, with a basket of fruit and warm bread.
lines.spoken: Clue number two was at the front door, with a basket of fruit and warm bread.

lines.text: Uncle Yusuf next door is unwell today. Let's share with him.
lines.spoken: Uncle Yusuf next door is unwell today. Let's share with him.
lines.hero: the family at the neighbour's door

lines.text: And I'll share my lunch with my friend Mia. She forgot hers!
lines.spoken: And I'll share my lunch with my friend Mia. She forgot hers!

lines.text: Clue number three came on the way home from the park.
lines.spoken: Clue number three came on the way home from the park.

lines.text: Some boys wanted me to skip school and be mean to a new kid. I said no, and walked away.
lines.spoken: Some boys wanted me to skip school and be mean to a new kid. I said no, and walked away.
lines.hero: Hamd turning away from a group of boys

lines.text: I'm proud of you. Good friends make you better. Choose them carefully.
lines.spoken: I'm proud of you. Good friends make you better. Choose them carefully.

lines.text: The last clue led to Grandpa's bench.
lines.spoken: The last clue led to Grandpa's bench.
lines.hero: CLUE 4 card, Grandpa on his bench

lines.text: Salaam, Grandpa! Let me carry your tea for you.
lines.spoken: Salaam, Grandpa! Let me carry your tea for you.

lines.text: Grandpa smiled the biggest smile of all.
lines.spoken: Grandpa smiled the biggest smile of all.

lines.text: Dad, we found every clue. But where's the treasure?
lines.spoken: Dad, we found every clue. But where's the treasure?

lines.text: Look around you. Mum, Grandpa, all of us together. Our family is the treasure.
lines.spoken: Look around you. Mum, Grandpa, all of us together. Our family is the treasure.
lines.hero: pull back: the whole family together

lines.text: Spend wisely. Waste nothing. Help others. Choose good friends. Respect your elders.
lines.spoken: Spend wisely. Waste nothing. Help others. Choose good friends. Respect your elders.
lines.hero: five lesson cards in a row

lines.text: And love your family most of all!
lines.spoken: And love your family most of all!

fact_notes: Fiction. Characters and art style taken from the user's earlier HeyGen cartoon clips (family dinner, Rehman House, Grandpa's bench).
Uncle Yusuf and Mia are invented side characters.
